name: Veilo practice auction
note: Practice auction, not a live one. The escrow address is the regtest address from demo/chain-probe, so it is inert on every real network: sending ZEC to it on mainnet burns them. The refund key is derived from 32 bytes of 0x55 and that secret is published in demo/README.md, so any refund address sealed here can be opened by anyone. A real auction publishes pk_refund only.
